Major Offenses - Category A.description: These are behaviors or actions that deviate or stray from the rules of the school and/or from student decorum and have greater implications or consequences to the individual, other persons, and the school.
Major Offenses - Category A.Second Offense: Suspension (minimum of three (3) school days, maximum of seven (7) school days)
Major Offenses - Category A.First Offense: Written Reprimand & Corrective Reinforcement (minimum of three (3) school days, maximum of seven (7) school days)

Major Offenses - Category B.First Offense: Suspension (minimum of three (3) school days, maximum of seven (7) school days)
Major Offenses - Category B.description: These are behaviors or actions that lead to damage or destruction of property or image or both of an individual, a group, the school, or the institution.

Major Offenses - Category C.First Offense: Suspension (minimum of seven (7) school days, maximum of 10 school days)
Major Offenses - Category C.description: These are behaviors or actions that leads to any of the following:
descriptionExamples: significant injury to the individual or other persons
endangering the safety and welfare of the individual and other persons
degrading the integrity of the person, school, or the institution

Major Offenses - Category D.description: These are behaviors or actions that are in direct violation of the Philippine laws.
Major Offenses - Category D.Offense: The sanction imposed for the commission of these offenses is either Exclusion/Expulsion.

Minor Offenses.description: These are behaviors or actions that deviate or stray from the rules of the school or stray from the rules of the school or from student decorum and have minimal implications or consequences to the individual, other persons, the school, or the institution.
